title: Lease-only renewal bypasses unresolved restore reconciliation and preserves a pre-restore writer generation
fix: Gate the normal renewal shortcut on valid current writer authority including restore/reconciliation state; retain no-epoch ordinary renewal, but require genuine recovery/new generation for a restored claim.
test_requirement: Restored still-future Session lease with absent/stale/wrong-bound/partial observations must not renew or claim acquired; ordinary active non-restored renewal must still succeed.
